title: The Thousand Brains Theory 2.0: An Extension for the Long-Range Connections of the Neocortical Heterarchy
abstract: arXiv:2507.05888v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vernon Mountcastle hypothesized that the basis for intelligence in mammals is the replication of a general computational unit, the cortical column. The Thousand Brains Theory proposed that each column is a sensorimotor system, capable of learning structured models of objects by integrating sensory input over multiple movements. Previous papers on the Thousand Brains Theory focused on the computations that occur within individual cortical columns, and how columns can use long-range connections to rapidly reach a consensus. However, several prominent long-range connection types in the neocortex were not addressed by the theory. These include hierarchical feedforward and feedback connections, as well as those that go through the thalamus. In addition, several theoretical requirements were not addressed. These include how the cortex learns compositional objects, and how information is converted from the egocentric perspective of se

translated_title: 千脑理论2.0：新皮层异质结构中长程连接的扩展
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.05888v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：Vernon Mountcastle假设哺乳动物智能的基础是一个通用计算单元——皮层柱的复制。千脑理论提出，每个皮层柱是一个感觉运动系统，能够通过整合多次运动中的感觉输入来学习物体的结构化模型。先前关于千脑理论的论文侧重于单个皮层柱内部的计算，以及皮层柱如何利用长程连接快速达成共识。然而，新皮层中几种显著的长程连接类型并未被该理论涵盖，包括层级前馈和反馈连接，以及通过丘脑的连接。此外，一些理论需求也未得到解决，例如皮层如何学习组合对象，以及信息如何从自我中心的视角转换。
tldr: 该论文扩展了千脑理论，将新皮层中的层级前馈/反馈连接和丘脑通路纳入统一框架，并解决了组合对象学习与视角转换的理论空白。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Thousand Brains Theory by incorporating hierarchical feedforward/feedback connections and thalamic pathways into a unified framework, addressing compositional learning and egocentric-to-allocentric perspective transformation gaps.
